notes: Example-only operator envelope. It narrows the operator_required inputs and does not claim a device limit.

linear_x.reason: example raw Twist component range; the native roll speed count is 0..255

linear_y.reason: example raw Twist component range; the callback uses y as the heading reference

red.reason: example ColorRGBA component range before the node multiplies by 255

green.reason: example ColorRGBA component range before the node multiplies by 255

blue.reason: example ColorRGBA component range before the node multiplies by 255

heading_rad.reason: example heading range; the node normalizes any angle with fmod

angular_velocity_rad.reason: example range derived from the native 0..255 count at 0.784 degrees/s
